author: reek
body: The manifest is derived from opening's declared type, so an effectful opening must declare its effects or it would ship an empty capability manifest and be denied every gated syscall at runtime. A value-binding opening (opening : T = body, no parameters) is checked the same as a function opening: block-read performs Device.Block, the declared Integer does not, so the def-boundary row-subset check rejects it. Declaring [Device.Block] Integer is the fix (see codex/test/apps/block-io-basic).
